reasoning_traces.think:
The system integrates three core mathematical primitives: Wilson-LCB for edge validation, Bayesian robust Kelly for stake sizing, and vine copulas for multivariate risk modeling. The Wilson-LCB ensures that only positive expected value propositions pass the first gate, enforcing a 100% fail-closed policy. The Bayesian robust Kelly engine dynamically adjusts stakes based on posterior belief updates and incorporates a coefficient of variation penalty to mitigate overexposure during sparse data regimes. Vine copulas provide a structured way to model dependencies among multiple outcomes, particularly in tail regions critical for parlays. These primitives collectively enforce a dual-layered integrity check: one grounded in frequentist statistical rigor and another rooted in Bayesian decision theory. The interplay between these components ensures that even if individual signals are noisy, the overall system remains robust against false positives due to strict adherence to Law 9 (fail-closed) and Law 12 (mandatory engine gate).
